title: Diprotic Acid Titration
body: 50 cm^3 of 0.15 mol/dm^3 sulfuric acid (H2SO4) is completely neutralized by potassium hydroxide (KOH). The balanced equation is: H2SO4 + 2KOH -> K2SO4 + 2H2O. Calculate the volume of 0.2 mol/dm^3 KOH solution required.
oer: Siyavula Grade 12 Physical Sciences - Acids and Bases
